concerns.concern: The photoresistance sign pattern (negative at the CNP, ν = ±4 and ν ≈ 2, positive in metallic regions) matches the sign of dρ/dT, so lattice heating could produce it. The monolayer graphene control does not rule this out, because doped MLG resistivity barely depends on lattice temperature and TBG cools to the lattice much faster.
concerns.quote: The sign pattern in your Fig. 2a,b ... is the sign of dρ/dT, which a warm lattice would also produce.

concerns.concern: The lattice temperature rise in the TBG channel at maximum power is not bounded, and electron and lattice temperatures are not extracted separately. The authors should also check whether ΔρTHz(n) simply follows dρ/dT(n) times a single temperature rise across all fillings, including where ρ is linear in T.
concerns.quote: Bound the channel lattice rise at Pmax, and plot ΔρTHz(n) against dρ/dT(n) for one device

concerns.concern: The T² resistivity below the umklapp threshold could come from temperature-dependent screening of charged impurities rather than interpocket e-e scattering. T/TF is not small at |ν| ≈ 0.1 (near 0.5 at the top of the fitted range), and this term has not been estimated.
concerns.quote: Estimate the impurity-screening T² term at |ν| ≈ 0.1 and 3.8, and replot Fig. 3b,c against T/TF

concerns.concern: The residual resistivity ρ0 subtracted in Fig. 3b,c is not given, nor is how it was chosen, so it may set the apparent T² exponent. Raw ρ(T) is shown only at four temperatures, and no free-exponent or local-slope analysis with varied ρ0 is shown.
concerns.quote: Give ρ0, plot raw ρ(T) at the four fillings, and show the local slope d ln(ρ − ρ0)/d ln T as ρ0 varies

concerns.concern: The T² claim below the umklapp threshold rests on a single device (1.58°). The total number of devices measured, how many showed the effects, and why any were set aside are not reported. A second 1.6–3° device in Fig. 3 form is requested.
concerns.quote: one device (1.58°) backs T² below umklapp

concerns.concern: The photoresistance in the 1.58° device at |ν| ≈ 0.1 and 3.8, where T² resistivity is reported, is not shown. This matters because the 2° device shows a negative response near the CNP.
concerns.quote: What does ΔρTHz look like in the 1.58° device at |ν| ≈ 0.1 and 3.8, where you report T² resistivity

concerns.concern: Parameter ranges are incompletely disclosed: only one frequency is used, Pmax has no absolute value, and no shown range is justified. Ranges measured beyond those shown, such as photoresistance at lattice temperatures above 2 K, are not stated.
concerns.quote: there is one frequency, Pmax has no absolute value, and no range carries a reason.

concerns.concern: The processing steps from raw data to figures are incomplete, including the ρ0 used in Fig. 3b,c. There is no data or code availability statement.
concerns.quote: the ρ0 in Fig. 3b,c and a data or code statement are missing.

concerns.concern: The text cites the wrong figure panels: the ρ(T) data and the dark/illuminated ρ(n) are cited as Fig. 1a and 1b but appear as Fig. 1c and 1d.
concerns.quote: The text cites "Figure 1a" for the ρ(T) data and "Fig. 1b" for the dark and illuminated ρ(n)
